proofs.run: red on the old commit: in a private worktree of c83fce8c (an ancestor of 0aa1558e) copy core/crates/engine/tests/engine_people.rs from this commit and run `cargo test -p engine --test engine_people`; each of the 5 tests must fail there (a compile error because contacts() or the people state paths do not exist is a red of kind 'does not build', say which)

notes: Claims and judges. (1) contacts() gives every address of mail received and sent with from and to counts: core/crates/engine/src/people.rs:243-263 (build loop: by_owner mails count to_count per recipient, others from_count) and core/crates/engine/src/rust_core.rs:629-630 (contacts, contact); judged by core/crates/engine/tests/engine_people.rs:64 a_contacts_is_not_empty_once_mail_is_stored (counts per account, own address excluded), :77 b_a_person_only_seen_as_a_recipient_of_sent_mail_is_listed_with_to_count, :89 b2_a_mail_in_the_sent_folder_from_an_alias_counts_its_recipients (a Sent mail from an alias still counts its recipient), :114 d_the_counts_move_when_a_mail_arrives. (2) a read by first letters: engine_people.rs:100 c_the_prefix_read_matches_a_first_name_a_last_name_and_an_address_accents_folded (people.rs:133-134 starts_with, :305 prefix read). (3) from the local store: people.rs:216 search_text::source::open_reader is the word-index reader for evidence, the people build reads the message table (module note people.rs:1-17). (4) a read during the build answers at once: core/crates/engine/tests/engine_people_build.rs:29 a_read_while_the_list_is_being_built_answers_at_once (prints 'four reads during the build took ...' at :51, needs --nocapture). (5) 'tests that fail on c83fce8c pass in the lead's cargo run': c83fce8c is an ancestor of this commit (git merge-base --is-ancestor checked); the red-first run on it is proof 2, kind lead, not run by anyone yet. A prior green: _captures/lead/main84-verify/cargo-ledger-search.log:707 'test result: ok. 4 passed' (engine_people). (6) seen red: three mutants from the build loop, find strings occur once in people.rs (lines 252, 258, 246); only b_ and d_ are sure to be the judging tests, the red regex also accepts the other test that reads the counts. (7) gap-engine-tests: proof 2 is new, core/crates/engine/tests/engine_people_speed.rs (5,000 received mails from 1,500 senders plus 500 Sent mails of 2 recipients; the three reads, cold and warm, each asserted under 50 ms, one printed line per read 'people read, <name>: N people from M mails in X ms'). Written, not run (nobody runs cargo in this lane): the lead's run decides; if contacts() over the 1,500 people is over 50 ms that is a finding for people.rs (cap or page it), never a reason to move the budget. The red-on-old-commit proof is now index 3 (it was 2).
